title: Famous Landmarks
text:
The Statue of Liberty is in New York. It is a big statue of a woman. She holds a torch in her hand. Many people take a boat to see it.

Big Ben is in London, in England. It is a famous clock. The clock is on a tall tower. It rings every hour.

questions.text: Where is the Statue of Liberty?
What does Big Ben do every hour?
options: It moves to a new city

questions.text: Why do many people take a boat to the Statue of Liberty?
options: They want to see the statue
They want to buy a car
They want to go to school
They want to swim in the sea

questions.text: What kind of place is Big Ben?

vocabulary.definition: a large figure of a person or animal made of stone, metal or another hard material
a stick that gives light and is held in the hand
a tall, narrow building or part of a building

paragraph_translations: Statua Wolności znajduje się w Nowym Jorku. To duży posąg kobiety. Trzyma pochodnię w ręku. Wiele osób płynie łodzią, żeby ją zobaczyć.
Big Ben znajduje się w Londynie, w Anglii. To słynny zegar. Zegar jest na wysokiej wieży. Bije co godzinę.
